summary: Frontend-only test of GST additions (per-row gst + bill-level tot_tax) on AddStockPurchaseForm and PurchaseReport. Login OK, Manual Entry form shows Vendor/Purchase Date/Invoice #/Fare/Total GST/Payment; items table headers #, Item, Qty, Unit, Unit Price, Amount, GST, Batch, Expiry. tot-tax-input and gst-input-0 present and accept numeric input. Row GST Total strip, confirm screen (GST column + Total GST line) and Grand Total (items+fare+tot_tax) correct. Submit payload verified by intercepting POST /api/proxy/v2/inventory/add-purchase (blocked, no real purchase created): contains tot_tax:18 and purchase_items[].gst:18, tot_amount 118. Keyboard Tab order qty->rate->gst->batch works. Split payment, vendor select, item search, batch auto-gen, expiry, Reset (clears gst & tot_tax) all still work. /reports/purchase shows GST column between Item Amt and Fare; existing row shows '—'.

ui_bugs.issue: Negative values accepted (min=0 is not enforced on typing). Entering -5 in Total GST reduced payable from 100 to 95 and would be sent as tot_tax:-5.

integration_issues.issue: Report never displays bill-level tot_tax. The transaction header row renders m.gst (line-level gst of the FIRST line) rather than tot_tax. For multi-item purchases the header GST shows only the first item's gst, which is misleading. vendor-item-list API response currently has no tot_tax key (keys: ..., tot_fair, tot_amount, gst, partial_payments) so backend/upstream may need to return it.

Per-row GST values and Total GST are independent. If user enters row GST (e.g. 5) and leaves Total GST empty, payable/tot_amount excludes GST (stays 100) and tot_tax:0 is sent while items carry gst. Consider auto-filling Total GST from Row GST Total (editable) or warning on mismatch.

action_items: PurchaseReport: show bill-level tot_tax in transaction header row (fallback to sum of line gst), keep line gst in sub-rows; confirm upstream vendor-item-list returns tot_tax
Decide/implement relationship between Row GST Total and Total GST (auto-sync or mismatch warning) so tot_amount includes GST consistently
Clamp/validate negative values for gst and tot_tax inputs
critical_code_review_comments: AddStockPurchaseForm.jsx is 968 lines - should be split (SpreadsheetRow, PaymentLegs, confirm screen into separate files)
PurchaseReport.jsx line ~295-300: ternary 'isMulti ? — : —' both branches identical - dead logic
Pre-existing: existing report row shows Item Amt ₹0 and Payment '—' (unrelated to this change)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested checks pass; 3 non-blocking issues

seed_data_creation: None - add-purchase request was intercepted and blocked; no purchase created on preprod
